claims.text: For \(i=j=p=c=2\), \(a=b=2\), so each accepted generating family has \(\binom42=6\) elements. Since each maps to a surjection \(\mathbb Z^6\twoheadrightarrow J_{2,4}/A_+J_{2,4}\cong\mathbb Z^6\), accepted indexed-family Nakayama implies that both \[ \{s_{22},s_{32},s_{42},s_{33},s_{43},s_{44}\} \quad\text{and}\quad \{s_{22},s_{221},s_{222},s_{2211},s_{2221},s_{2222}\} \] map to \(\mathbb Z\)-bases of the quotient. Hence neither has a proper subfamily generating \(J_{2,4}\).
The requested target is established: both listed families are minimal generating sets of \(J_{2,4}\). No broader minimality claim is concluded.
